g.text: IoT Pavement Sensor Network HUD & Sub-Surface Stress Monitor
Peak Heavy Commercial Load on WEH-NH8
Sub-Surface Pavement Cross-Section & Embedded Sensor Array
L1: WEARING COURSE (50mm Bituminous Asphalt) • Temp: 39.4°C
L2: DENSE BITUMINOUS MACADAM BINDER (100mm) • Shear Stress: 64 MPa
L3: WET MIX MACADAM SUB-BASE (250mm) • Moisture: 28.9% (CRITICAL)
L4: NATURAL SUB-GRADE & WATER TABLE • Pore Pressure: 18.4 kPa
Component: SensorHeatmap.tsx • Micro-strain (µε) by KM Segment
● Red (>350 µε): Structural Sub-Base Delamination Risk • ● Amber (200–350 µε): Fatigue
Real-Time Pavement Sensor Node Stream & Automated Inspection Triggers
Streams into road_defect_history (source = 'inspection') when micro-strain > 350 µε or moisture > 25%
BOUND DBMS RELATIONS: roads, road_defect_history, road_materials, complaints
ROADWATCH DBMS • Kanak Waradkar (24B-CO-030) • Krushna Surve (24B-CO-031) • Manjunath Gavada (24B-CO-035)
